Name: Nyapu Grandma
Author: amillionand1fandoms
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Replace Grandpa's portrait with a Grandma portrait in the style of Nyapu. Meant to be used alongside Aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47340]Grandma[/url] mod. If you want anything besides JUST the portraits to be replaced, you need Aedenthorn's mod.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Extract it from the .zip and put it in your mods folder.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]If you have other mods that replace Grandpa's portrait (For example, Slightly Cuter Characters) you should turn off Grandpa in those mods.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Nyapu for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]awesome portraits[/url] and generous permissions[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Aedenthorn for the Grandma mod that inspired this[/color]
